pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices. Individual patch edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients and low-contrast transitions likely exacerbated by image blur and sensor noise.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light tan pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. The pathway thickness is non-uniform, appearing wider at nodal intersections than along linear segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A visible dark brown jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The contour displays low-amplitude, moderate-frequency serrations against the background pixels.
